newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Palestinians denounce US house resolution.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Palestinians denounce US house resolution.

text.p: Palestinians in Lebanon observed on Saturday a general strike to denounce a U.S. congressional resolution calling on President Bill Clinton to reaffirm that Jerusalem must remain Israel's undivided capital.

Palestinian guerrillas burned tires and U.S. and Israeli flags at the entrance of Ain el-Hilweh camp near the port of Sidon, the biggest of the 12 Palestinian refugee camps in Lebanon and home to 75,000 refugees.
Schools and shops closed in the other camps across Lebanon, home to some 225,000 Palestinians.
Supporters of PLO leader Yasser Arafat said they had called the strikes in denunciation of the U.S. resolution.

Israel, which captured Arab East Jerusalem in 1967 and annexed it in a move unrecognised by the international community including the United States, welcomed Tuesday's 406-17 House of Representatives vote, which does not however oblige the Clinton administration to act.
A PLO statement on Thursday denounced the move as "a declaration of war on the Palestinian people."
